subject: Transient burst carve-out for upcoming demo — NovusHealth pilot
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@novushealth.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: ops+platform@novushealth.ai
Date: 2027-06-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: demo next week — temporary higher burst needed

Hi Ben,

Quick note — our engineering team is planning a small public demo of the Novus conversational assistant next Tuesday (6/15). The demo will spike traffic for about 20 minutes while multiple clinicians interact with the system concurrently.

Current production usage is modest, but for the demo we expect a short-lived burst that would exceed our current per-minute quota (we estimate a peak of ~1,200 requests/min for ~20 minutes). Can Redwood grant a temporary carve-out or elevated burst window for the demo?

We need to know:
- whether this is possible without a formal contract amendment,
- any guardrails (rate caps, concurrency limits) you would enforce, and
- what monitoring/alerts you need on our side so we don’t hit fair-use protections.

If helpful I can share a quick csv with expected time series; we can also schedule a 20-min sync with your SREs.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Senior PM, Platform Integrations
NovusHealth

---
Attachment: expected_traffic_sample.csv (csv stub)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Elena Park <elena.park@novushealth.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-07T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: demo next week — temporary higher burst needed

Elena — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the demo. We can accommodate a short burst window but want to set clear limits so the platform remains fair for other tenants.

High level proposal:
- Temporary burst carve-out for a 30-minute window on 2027-06-15 from 10:00–10:30 PT; peak rate allowed: 1,500 req/min.
- We’ll enforce an aggregate concurrency cap and a per-IP/requester soft-throttle at 1,800 req/min to avoid noisy neighbors.
- Redwood will turn on elevated logging and a short retention of debug traces for that window. We will not change your SLA uptime figure for the demo; this is a limited operational exception, not a permanent quota change.

Action items for Novus:
1) Share the expected request time series (csv) by EOD Friday 6/11.
2) Agree to a simple runbook: abort criteria (if error rate > 5% sustained for 3 min) and a single ops contact reachable by phone during the window.
3) Provide a short list of client IPs or service tokens that will be part of the demo.

Looping in Marissa from your account team for commercial confirmation and Soojin from SRE to vet the technical guardrails.

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, Elena Park <elena.park@novushealth.ai>

Date: 2027-06-07T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: RE: demo next week — temporary higher burst needed

Elena / Ben — I reviewed the numbers you sent in the csv and did a quick capacity check. A short 30-min burst at the requested peak is feasible with the following guardrails:

Technical guardrails we’ll apply:
- Burst window: 2027-06-15 10:00–10:30 PT (server time).
- Peak allowed: 1,500 req/min aggregate for the Novus tokens listed below.
- Soft throttles: incremental backoff triggered at 1,600 req/min; hard reject at 1,900 req/min.
- Error-based abort: if error rate (5xx) > 5% sustained for 180s we’ll kill the elevated window and fall back to your standard quota.
- Monitoring: we’ll enable detailed latency & token-cost tracing for the window and push an alert to your ops channel + our SRE rotations.

Operational notes:
- Please provide the service tokens or the exact hostnames that will originate demo traffic; we will pin the carve-out to those identifiers.
- We can provide a short post-mortem if anything is triggered.

Posting a small runbook as an attachment (pilot-runbook-monitoring.md).

SoojIN Lee
SRE, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Elena Park <elena.park@novushealth.ai>, ben_carter@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-09T16:45:00-07:00

Elena — confirming commercial side. For this single 30-minute operational carve-out we don’t need a full contract amendment. Two commercial points:

1) Usage: any token/req over your standard quota during the window will be billed at your current overage rate; we will not retroactively change the per-token price.
2) Credits: as a courtesy for being a pilot customer we’ll apply a $750 credit to the invoice if the elevated window is used and runbook/abort criteria were followed.

If that sounds good I’ll draft a one-page SLA addendum and attach it to this thread. Ben — I’ll leave final scheduling to you and Soojin to lock the exact tokens/ips.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success — Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
